original: Guys, I know you're all feeling\ndown after what happened to\nPiccolomon...
But if all we do is think about\nit, we're not gonna to be able to\nget anything done.
We have to keep going, for\nPiccolomon's sake.
You're right. This won't be a safe\nplace for long, either.
You've seen a lot of horrible\nthings happen as soon as we came\nto the Digital World.
So it must be a lot more painful\nfor you than it is for me...
I don't want Piccolomon mad at us.
Piccolomon was always getting mad\nat us...
He said that even though we were\nthe Chosen Children, we were an\neyesore.
So he always had high expectations\nfor you.
Right! So we can't let Piccolomon\ndown!
So let's give it our all together,\nHikari!
It really makes me sad, knowing\nthat all the Digimon we knew\naren't here anymore...
I don't know if we can keep going\nat this rate…
I wonder if I can get any\nstronger...
Seems like Yamato's feeling\ndown... what can I do to make him\ncheer up?
You can make food for him.
It's best to just take it slowly.
You're right! If he eats\nsomething, he'll feel better!\nThanks, Jou!
But I want Yamato to cheer up...
Everyone has times when they want\nto take it slowly.
I shouldn't rely on Yamato all the\ntime...
Maybe if you give them more time...
That's good. I'm currently\ndevoting myself to analyzing the\nDark Masters' data.
We're counting on you! We need a\nway to defeat them.
Really...? Perhaps it's not the\ntime to be analyzing the Dark\nMasters...
Well, we don't really have an easy\nsolution right now.
Such a huge difference in power,\neven though they're also\nUltimates...
For some reason, I feel like we've\nbeen here before. Ah!
This is the shore on File Island,\nwhere we met the Digimon for the\nfirst time...
This isn't the time to be saying\nyou're tired, guys! We have to\nsave everyone!
Thanks, Agumon! You've all gotten\nreally strong.
Why do you think so, Taichi?
When we fought Shellmon before, we\nwere having trouble...
When you put it like that...
We've just joined them, so we've\ngot some ways to go.
It's okay, they said everyone's\ngetting stronger!
Why is there a beach hut here?
It's totally a trap! I'm not going!
What do you mean? We're checking\nit out *because* it's suspicious,\nright?
While you're talking about all\nthat, we're gonna eat all the food\nthey have!
I want to, but... I can't just go\nafter I said all that...
We have to hurry, or they'll eat\neverything!
Don't worry about it, let's go!
Hahaha! This isn't just any old\nbeach hut, you know.
This place sucks energy out from\nyou, making it your deathbed!
I feel like I'm losing power...
I did it, I did it! I collected\nall the Chosen Children!
So it was all a trap...
I'll take your energy while I'm\nhere!
We've got no choice but to fight!
Looks like we knocked him out!
All right, let's save everyone\nwhile we have the chance!
When he started taking away our\nenergy, we were gonna be done\nfor...
Sorry, Jou, this wouldn't have\nhappened if we'd listened to\nyou...
It's my fault, really. I should\nhave been more emphatic about\nholding you guys back.
Whaaaaat?! You're not gonna eat\nthe curry rice?
We're just gonna pop in for a bit,\nright, Jou? You're worrying way\ntoo much.
I have, up until now, and it's\nbeen for the better! But now's not\nthe time to be arguing about that!
Let's be a little more careful.
Hey, Jou, you got your point\nacross!
You've been rambling on and on\nabout this for way too long! Hurry\nup and get in the beach hut!
He must be one of the Dark\nMasters' minions!
So the beach hut was a trap after\nall?!
Now that it's come to this, I'll\nhave to take your energy after I\ndefeat you!
Yeah, Jou's always the one with\nthe straightest head around here.
But from now on, the Dark Masters\nwill be trying all sorts of funny\nstuff against us.
Yeah. We need to brace ourselves.
So what do we do now?
The only thing we can do is run...\nbut at this rate, we won't be a\nmatch for them...
Yeah, that's the only thing we can\ndo...
I saw Whamon's silhouette. They\nprobably fled into the sea...
The Chosen Children and the\nDigimon... They can't flee from\nme into the sea...
Hey, Taichi. Shouldn't we rest for\na bit?
Huh? Yeah, but if we do, the Dark\nMasters might...
Sora's right, Taichi. It should be\nfine if we rest a bit.
Hey, hey. Where are we going?
Maybe we should rest a bit longer...
This isn't the time to be resting!
